description: California Rail Network is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. The purpose of the data is to represent the rail network using available reference data and information contained in the California Region Timetable 20. The Rail feature class contains alignment for passenger and freight railroad lines, including commuter rail and heavy rail. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure. Its tags are baaqmd-opendata, baaqmd, baaqmd-mdm, rail. The table has 26 columns. Attribution on the portal: Caltrans, Division of Transportation Planning. The portal shows 2024-02-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
